name: Casting and the Bite
description: Hold to cast, watch the float or feel the tap, strike in time.

pages.title: Casting and the Bite
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- **Hold** use to charge a cast and let go; a full charge takes a second.
- A bite shows as a **dipping float** or a **tap** on the rod tip.
- **Strike** by **lifting the rod** (left click) within about a second.
- A rod only casts with line and a hook (or a lure), and a reel unless it is a pole.

**Casting.** A full cast goes 8 metres plus 7 for every metre of rod. A rig much lighter or heavier than the rod's casting range ("Casts 5-30 g best" on its tooltip) falls short. A pole reaches only as far as its 8 m of line, and no cast goes further than the line on the reel.

**Rigs.**

- A **float** holds the bait at the surface and dips on a bite.
- A **sinker** takes the bait to the bottom; the rod tip taps on a bite.
- A **lure** needs no bait. Wind it back by holding use: it dives to its depth, and works when it moves at the speed it likes. Lifting the rod twitches it toward you.

The reel holds its line while the rig waits: walk off or sail away and you drag the rig along, at the same line out.

**The bite.** A plop on the float or a tap on the rod, and **Bite! Lift the rod to strike** blinks above the hotbar. Left-click within the window: about 1.4 s on a float or sinker, 1 s on a lure. Reeling never sets the hook; a rod held high can't strike.\
\
Miss it and the fish lets go. Three times in ten it takes the bait with it.

Junk, treasure and crates are struck the same way and come in as a dead weight.\
\
**Enchantments**: Lure and Luck of the Sea work on every rod. Each level of Lure cuts the wait by about 15%%; luck moves the roll from junk toward treasure and rare fish. Unbreaking and Mending work too.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** **Wait times.** A rig fish want, in a good spot, gets a bite about every 17 seconds on average; a poor match about once a minute; a bare hook nothing wants, two minutes or more. No wait runs past four minutes.\
\
Rain shortens waits by 15%%. Lava waits are 1.6 times as long, void waits 1.8 times.

**Open water** is a 5x5 patch of water at least two blocks deep with open air above it around the rig. Treasure and crates only come from open water; fish don't care.\
\
Catches tire a spot: see [#](2E5AAC)[Where Fish Live](entry://fishing/where_fish_live)[#](). Operators can cast and type `/cgfish hook` to see how many species can bite there and the average wait.
